anchors.title: Mooloolaba Beach & Esplanade
anchors.description: The Sunshine Coast's most popular beach — a patrolled, family-safe arc backed by a palm-lined esplanade of cafes and gelato bars. Stinger nets in summer.

anchors.title: Australia Zoo
anchors.description: Steve Irwin's wildlife park on the Sunshine Coast hinterland — 1,200+ animals, daily Wildlife Warriors Show in the Crocoseum, and the Tiger Walk. Allow a full day.

anchors.title: Noosa National Park Coastal Walk
anchors.description: Pandanus-and-eucalypt clifftop trail from Hastings Street to Hell's Gates and back. Easy 5km return; spot koalas in the spotted gums and turtles in the surf below.

anchors.title: Glass House Mountains Lookout
anchors.description: Captain Cook's view from 1770 — eleven volcanic plugs rising abruptly from the coastal plain. Drive 40 minutes inland for the easy 1km Glass House Mountains Lookout walk.

anchors.title: Maleny Dairies Tour
anchors.description: Working dairy farm in the Sunshine Coast hinterland with daily 90-minute farm tours — bottle-feed calves, milk a cow, then taste the dairy's flavoured milks. Family-run since 2003.

WEDNESDAY.title: Eumundi Markets
WEDNESDAY.description: Australia's most awarded artisan markets in the heritage village of Eumundi. 600+ stalls of designers, makers and live performers. Wednesdays 8am-1:30pm, Saturdays 7am-2pm.

SATURDAY.title: Eumundi Markets — Saturday
SATURDAY.description: The big Saturday session at Eumundi — packed lanes, live buskers and the best chance to meet the makers. 7am-2pm.
